newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Assembly paves way for state tobacco suits.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Assembly paves way for state tobacco suits.

text.p: California's Assembly gave final approval on Wednesday to a bill that would clear the way for the state to sue major tobacco companies to recoup public health-care costs related to smoking.
The state Assembly approved the bill on a vote of 64-to-10, sending it to Republican Gov. Pete Wilson for review. A spokesman for the governor was not immediately available to comment on the measure.
The bill was approved by the Senate earlier this week.
